chapter: Big band, Chicago players, recordings and gospel
title: The sizes of his big bands over the years
summary: His band fluctuated with economic conditions, starting with six pieces and growing to thirteen after the 1943 move across the street.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Quitting the band: why sidemen left

blocks.x: Right. You've always been identified with big bands, I think, ever since the Delisa days.
Tell me something about your experiences with your own big band, at the Delisa and after-
wards, and some of the guys that were in it, and --
Tell me something about the bands that you had, or did you just consider one band, or were there separate bands?
No, I mean, the bands wouldn't break up, but you just as well have said break up, because they -- the sizes fluctuated.
Was that because of economic conditions?
Well, yes, due to economic conditions. We started with a six-piece band.
Yeah, right, we started with a six-piece, and we kept that going for awhile, and then when we moved across the street in 1943, then we enlarged the band, see, we enlarged it to about 13 men.
